title: Ecochus
description: Adds some pokémon made by the youtuber EcoSwap
body:
This datapack adds the variants and evolutions of Pikachu seen in EcoSwap's vido "Can Pikachu Survive in Skull Island?"

watch the vido here!
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/o5ciIA82tTQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Content:
Quarrychu
an ground type pikachu

Pikleener
an electric/feiry type pikachu

Nosferachu
an electric/dark type pikachu

Pikaiju
a powerful electric/fighting evolution of Pikachu(doesn't evolve form pikachu in game)
